info.name: Yearn Finance yDaemon REST Chains Vaults API
Get all vaults for a chain

params.name: chainID
params.description: The EVM chain ID. Supported values: 1 (Ethereum), 10 (Optimism), 137 (Polygon), 250 (Fantom), 8453 (Base), 42161 (Arbitrum).

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Determines the order of returned vaults.

params.name: orderDirection
params.description: Determines the direction of ordering.

params.name: strategiesCondition
params.description: Filters strategies based on specified condition.

params.name: hideAlways
params.description: If true, hides certain vaults.

params.name: migrable
params.description: Filters vaults based on migration status.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for pagination.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of vaults per page.

params.name: chainIDs
params.description: Comma-separated list of chain IDs to filter vaults.

items.docs: Retrieve all vaults for a specified chain ID. Supports pagination, ordering, and filtering by strategy conditions and details. Returns vaults matching the IsYearn inclusion filter by default.

params.name: chainID
params.description: The EVM chain ID. Supported values: 1 (Ethereum), 10 (Optimism), 137 (Polygon), 250 (Fantom), 8453 (Base), 42161 (Arbitrum).

params.name: address
params.description: The EVM contract address of the vault.

params.name: strategiesCondition
params.description: Filters strategies based on specified condition.

items.docs: Retrieve data for a single vault by chain ID and contract address. Returns vault metadata, APY, TVL, strategy details, and token information.

info.name: Get all V2 vaults for a chain

params.name: chainID
params.description: The EVM chain ID. Supported values: 1 (Ethereum), 10 (Optimism), 137 (Polygon), 250 (Fantom), 8453 (Base), 42161 (Arbitrum).

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Determines the order of returned vaults.

params.name: orderDirection
params.description: Determines the direction of ordering.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for pagination.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of vaults per page.

items.docs: Returns all V2 vaults matching the IsYearn inclusion filter. Filters vaults where the major version number is not 3.

info.name: Get all V3 vaults for a chain

params.name: chainID
params.description: The EVM chain ID. Supported values: 1 (Ethereum), 10 (Optimism), 137 (Polygon), 250 (Fantom), 8453 (Base), 42161 (Arbitrum).

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Determines the order of returned vaults.

params.name: orderDirection
params.description: Determines the direction of ordering.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for pagination.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of vaults per page.

items.docs: Returns all V3 vaults matching the IsYearn inclusion filter. Filters vaults where the kind is Multiple or Single, or the major version number is 3.

info.name: Get all retired vaults for a chain

params.name: chainID
params.description: The EVM chain ID. Supported values: 1 (Ethereum), 10 (Optimism), 137 (Polygon), 250 (Fantom), 8453 (Base), 42161 (Arbitrum).

params.description: Number of vaults per page.

items.docs: Returns all retired vaults. Filters vaults where the Metadata.IsRetired flag is true.
